tspan.tspan: My name is Felix Zaj (aka Felix Zajitschek,
for evolutionary biology and photography),
a visual artist and writer based in Formby,
Liverpool, UK. Born in Munich, I've lived and
worked as an evolutionary biologist in France,
Sweden, the US, and Australia, drawing
glo-
I work primarily with ink on paper, exploring
lines and negative space through minimalist
abstract drawings and mixed media. My style
blends contemplative miksang-inspired forms
for capturing everyday essence in black-and-

text.tspan: white, with occasional vivid colors for energy.

tspan.tspan: Themes often revolve around life maps,
transience, and resilience. I write short sto-
ries and novels, mainly in German, delving
into identity, self, and human nature.
Collaborations, like street art books or pho-

text.tspan: tography with family, enrich my work.
